title: Optimize FTS token deduplication
rationale: FTS index maintenance and MATCH evaluation repeatedly tokenized text into Vec<String> and then collected into HashSet<String>. A shared tokenize_unique helper performs tokenization and deduplication in one pass, avoiding the intermediate Vec allocation and redundant delete work for repeated old tokens.
steps: Add Executor::tokenize_unique for lowercase alphanumeric token deduplication
Use the helper in FTS index backfill and DML index maintenance
Use the helper in non-indexed and indexed MATCH paths
Add focused unit coverage for duplicate token handling
expected_impact: Reduces intermediate allocations and repeated FTS index operations on text with duplicate terms.
